body.cap: Neurélux brain health lighting solution | Provided by Korea Lighting

body.x: Korea Lighting Inc. (CEO Dongwoo Lee) announced that it will participate in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and technology exhibition, to be held in Las Vegas, the United States, from Tuesday, January 6 to Friday, January 9 (local time).

Korea Lighting is a company specializing in functional optical semiconductor platforms and solutions. The company has steadily introduced products to domestic and global markets that support beauty and health improvement while also delivering substantial aesthetic value as lighting fixtures.

In particular, Korea Lighting has earned recognition for its technological edge through its core proprietary technology, HS FRAME, which integrates LED chips, circuitry, and thermal management into a single platform. The company explained that this technology enables stable, efficient output at high-power wavelengths suitable for medical-grade applications, while also enhancing design completeness and flexibility in compact platform products.

At CES 2026, Korea Lighting will highlight its healthcare product Neurélux, which is based on the HS FRAME technology. The company describes Neurélux as an “Ambient Brain Healthcare” solution that enables brain health management within everyday living environments.

As a wellness product, Neurélux derives its functionality from two near-infrared wavelengths, 810 nm and 1,064 nm. The 810 nm wavelength promotes mitochondrial activation in brain cells and plays a key role in neuroprotection and regeneration. It is selectively absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase, increasing the production of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), a high-energy compound that, in turn, supports the recovery of damaged neural tissue and reduces inflammation.

body.cap: Neurélux used as a bedside lamp | Provided by Korea Lighting

body.x: The 1,064 nm wavelength penetrates more deeply into brain tissue, generating subtle thermal stimulation that activates ion channels in cell membranes, increasing neuroplasticity and cerebral blood flow. This effect enhances the supply of oxygen and nutrients to brain cells and supports higher-order cognitive functions such as working memory and attention.

Neurélux also offers high usability in daily life through an adjustable stand joint that flexibly adapts to installation locations, along with a minimalist design. Users can also use it as a general household lighting fixture, similar to a conventional lamp, by operating it as a light source rather than an infrared emitter. Unlike wearable devices that require continuous physical contact for biometric monitoring, Neurélux adopts a non-invasive, non-contact approach, further improving accessibility.

A Korea Lighting official said, “Neurélux is a solution that helps manage age-related dementia, one of the major challenges of a super-aged society, as well as various sleep disorders, in everyday life and in a completely new way,” adding, “As the industry’s first non-contact brain healthcare solution, we expect it to reshape the related market and secure a clear technological advantage.”

The official continued, “Neurélux will be unveiled for the first time at CES 2026 ahead of its launch in March, and this exhibition will serve as a key stage for accelerating the globalization of Korea Lighting as a functional optical semiconductor platform company,” adding, “Through this event, we plan to pursue strategic partnerships with leading healthcare companies and buyers in North America and Europe, and work to establish our proprietary technology as a global standard.”
